answer: `record_refund(reference, amount)` normalizes the reference by stripping surrounding whitespace and lowercasing it, then passes the normalized value and unchanged amount to `append_refund` ([ledger/service.py:15](repository/ledger/service.py), [ledger/pricing.py:7](repository/ledger/pricing.py)). Storage builds a record with those values, appends it to the in-memory `REFUNDS` list, and returns the record ([ledger/storage.py:1](repository/ledger/storage.py)).
